facts.text: Russian Girls is performed by Sasha Dith.
Artist: Sasha Dith · Title: Russian Girls · Album: Russian Girls · Year: 2005 · Genre: Euro House · Path: /Users/bobhopp/DJ MEDIA/VIDEO/TECHNO/Sasha Dith - Russian Girls.mp4
MBAND is a Russian boy band, founded by producer and composer Konstantin Meladze.
The group was established on November 22, 2014 after the grand final of the singing competition "I Want to Meladze".
The band's first single, "She will be back", has become one of the most played songs in Russia in 2015.

Rudi Frank Harold Schwamborn (German pronunciation: [ˈʁuːdiː ˈʃvamˌbɔʁn]; born in Avenues, Harare, Zimbabwe), professionally known as Carlprit,  is a German-Zimbabwean rapper, songwriter, DJ and music manager.
He has performed and written for acts such as Cascada, Alexandra Stan and Laurent Wolf.
Schwamborn is best known for his song "Fiesta" as well as his appearance in Cascada's 2009 hit single "Evacuate the Dancefloor".
